findings.description: Definition artifact, contextual working role and proposition content are distinct. Working adoption status does not assert proposition truth in the metatheory; sibling lineage/aliases do not establish semantic equivalence or global disjointness.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and reasoning-context owners must review carrier, role identity and explicit assumption selection.

findings.description: Unestablished epistemic status is distinct from actual falsity. Characteristically/typically low veracity and often high conviction require qualitative or quantitative semantics and cannot become universal values by removing their qualifiers.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and D23 owner must confirm epistemic, truth and axis denotations.

findings.description: Four carried metadata relations enforce presence only, without selecting admitted data types, uniqueness, policy contents, route liveness, satisfied retirement guards or actual evidence.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and artifact/route owners must review carrier contracts, cardinalities and operational obligations.

findings.description: Evidence-gated promotion, revision and retirement require guarded state transitions and selected authority. Conviction, posture metadata and adoption do not establish a promotion event or successful lifecycle execution.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and Authority Promotion owner must decide source guards, evidence strength and actual route/consumer preservation.

findings.description: Provisional grounding, may-complement/stand-alone alternatives and hedge-marker classification remain open operational/inference contracts. Mutual Axiom, Hypothesis and Invariant references require joint semantic review without fixed-point inference.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and counterpart owners must select actual dependency/carrier mappings and jointly review semantic cycles.
